title: Unit orientations have operator norm at most 1
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let Q be a linear subspace of ℝ^P (Euclid P) and let ξ ∈ MultiVector P n = (Covector (Euclid P) n →L[ℝ] ℝ). Here Covector (Euclid P) n is the normed space of continuous alternating n-linear forms on ℝ^P with the operator norm, and MultiVector P n carries the operator norm of continuous linear functionals. Suppose IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q: there is an orthonormal family τ = (τ_1, …, τ_n) in ℝ^P spanning Q such that either ξ(α) = α(τ_1, …, τ_n) for every n-covector α, or ξ(α) = −α(τ_1, …, τ_n) for every n-covector α. Then ‖ξ‖ ≤ 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ξ : MultiVector P n), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → ‖ξ‖ ≤ 1
